function: Cascaded and direct channel estimation for IRS-assisted mmWave MIMO: a Pix2pix conditional GAN (U-Net generator) maps received pilots to channel matrices (pp. 5-6).
system: FDD downlink; BS with M=32 antennas, K=4 single-antenna users, passive reflecting IRS with N=32 elements; mmWave, carrier frequency not stated (pp. 3, 9).
method: Pix2pix conditional GAN: U-Net generator and patch discriminator trained adversarially with cGAN loss plus L1 loss (eta=100); supervised offline training on simulated channels (pp. 6-9).
data_channel: Own Saleh-Valenzuela simulator, 10 paths per link; 40000 samples of 32x32 channels, split 60/20/20 into training, validation, test; noise added at set SNRs (p. 9).
test_conditions: Matched training and test data with SNR sweeps; mismatch tests: trained on 2, 6 or 10 paths, tested on mixed 10-path and 2/6-path channels; mixed-SNR training (pp. 12-13).
baselines: Non-learned: LS and LMMSE. Learned: MLP [23], SFCNN [30], and the earlier conditional-GAN estimator of the same authors [13] (pp. 9-11).
metrics: NMSE of the cascaded channel versus SNR, eta, pilot contamination, pilot length, BS antennas, IRS elements, number of paths and training SNR; training curves; runtime (pp. 10-13).
complexity: FLOPs O(sum_s M_s1 M_s2 F_s^2 L_s L_(s-1)) for Pix2pix-cGAN, compared with LS, LMMSE, MLP and SFCNN orders; runtime about 2.5e-2 s per pilot signal (pp. 8-9).
q1_support: p. 9: "The Saleh-Valenzuela channel model is utilized to generate channel samples" The channels come from the authors' own Saleh-Valenzuela simulator; no 3GPP TR 38.901, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 12: "we also test the robustness of the Pix2pix-cGAN based method to different numbers of paths in Fig. 11" The model is trained with 2, 6 or 10 paths and tested on a mixed set that includes the other path number; the loss from the change of channel statistics is reported.
q3_support: p. 9: "compare it with the DL-based schemes such as SFCNN and MLP" and "we compare the proposed method with the non-DL channel estimation approaches, namely, LS and LMMSE"; Fig. 6 (p. 10) also includes the GAN estimator of [13].
q4_support: p. 8: "We adopt the number of floating point operations (FLOPs) as the metric" and give the FLOPs order of the proposed Pix2pix-cGAN; p. 9 adds a measured runtime of about 2.5e-2 s per pilot signal.
q5_support: p. 9: "In order to train and test the Pix2pix-cGAN, we generate 40000 channel samples" The data are produced by the authors' simulator; the paper gives no code or data link and uses no public dataset.
notes: Included as area 2 (channel estimation, direct and cascaded, in an IRS-assisted MIMO system). q2 rests on Fig. 11 (p. 12), the path-number mismatch between training and test; Fig. 12 (p. 13) adds a training-SNR mismatch, which alone would not count. The GAN of [13] is an earlier paper of the same first author, so it serves as the earlier learned baseline together with MLP and SFCNN. The paper states mmWave but no carrier frequency.
